title: 18-route CPU and archived GPU-output qualification
population: Privately qualified historical model-repeat routes; public summary only.
metric: Exact CPU-output equality for the recovered reference implementation; archived GPU-array elementwise tolerance status; recorded maximum absolute difference and failing-element counts.
units: 512 validation rows × 2 output elements/route; raw maximum difference mixes N/kg and m/s outputs.
grouping: Nine model families M0–M8, with repeats r0 and r1 per family.
uncertainty: No interval; qualification is a recorded deterministic comparison, not an empirical accuracy estimate.
caption_tex: Numerical qualification of 18 model-repeat routes (M0--M8, repeats r0 and r1). (a) Recovered CPU outputs are recorded as exactly equal to the original CPU outputs on every route; comparison with archived GPU arrays is within the unchanged elementwise tolerance for M0--M3 and outside it for both repeats of M4--M8. (b) Recorded maximum absolute difference per route on a logarithmic axis. The two outputs have different units (N/kg and m/s), so the values are not comparable as physical magnitudes. A difference below the absolute tolerance \(10^{-5}\) (dashed line) always passes; the criterion also has a relative term, so the maximum alone does not determine status. (c) Number of failing elements out of 1,024 (512 rows by two outputs) where tabulated (n/t: not tabulated). These are recorded comparisons, not a new GPU replay or an accuracy evaluation.
